meta.name: memory-ingest
meta.description: Transform validated knowledge into structured long-term memory. Activate after Bootstrap scan, after Discovery produces validated artefacts, or after architecture insights are available.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将验证过的知识结构化存入长期记忆
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在构建需要长期记忆的智能体系统
copy.tagline_en: Transform validated knowledge into structured long-term memory
copy.fit_line_en: For you if building agent systems that need persistent memory

howto.what: 将验证过的发现、决策、架构洞见等知识写入项目记忆文件并更新索引，同时执行防冲突检查、影响扫描和元数据治理。只处理已验证知识，不存储原始会话。
howto.when: 在引导扫描后、发现技能产出验证制品后、或新的已验证项目知识需要持久化时触发。仅处理已验证知识。

say.text: 请保存刚才验证的架构决策到长期记忆。
say.note: 触发记忆写入，更新相关文件

say.text: 把我验证过的市场假设存入内存。
记录已验证的项目约束到project context。
say.note: 自动更新索引和领域索引

howto.what_en: Writes validated findings, decisions, architecture insights, etc. into project memory files and updates indexes, with collision guard, impact scan, and freshness metadata governance. Only validated knowledge, never raw sessions.
howto.when_en: Activates after Bootstrap scan, after Discovery produces validated artefacts, or when validated project knowledge needs persistence. Only processes validated knowledge.

say_en.text: Save the validated architecture decision to long-term memory.
say_en.note: Triggers memory write and index update

say_en.text: Store my validated market hypothesis in memory.
